name: ModelVariant178_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant178_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a square of grid lines fades in around the slot, a strip wall rises from two of its edges, rows of boxes grow at random grid crossings and full-screen texture bands scroll with wavy row offsets); for a non-negative request it selects the 0x2A-byte config row indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the grid, box picks and band phases, packs three texture words and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 while the boxes grow, 1 once after them, 0 until the fade and light ramp end and then 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-195 and 325 images build it from the same source without the work-size printf, sized for 256 PAL lines, and bind its data names 0x58 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
